title: AdWinner Intel - Competitive Ad Intelligence
description: Find proven winning ads across Meta Ad Library and TikTok. Longevity-based profitability scoring + Gemini AI creative analysis.

action.title: Action
enumTitles: Analyze Domain Winners — find proven ads for a domain
Extract Marketing Hooks — AI-analyze a single creative
Get Trend Report — trending ads in a niche (TikTok)
Ad Profitability Score — score an individual ad
Get Raw FB Ads — raw Meta Ad Library data
Get Raw TikTok Ads — raw TikTok content data

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Advertiser domain to analyze (e.g., "glossier.com", "huel.com"). Used by: analyze_domain_winners, get_raw_fb_ads.

platform.title: Platform(s)
platform.description: Which ad platform(s) to search. Used by: analyze_domain_winners.

minLongevityDays.title: Min Longevity Days
minLongevityDays.description: Minimum days an ad must be running to qualify as a 'winner'. Higher = stricter filter. Used by: analyze_domain_winners.

includeAnalysis.title: Include AI Creative Analysis
includeAnalysis.description: Run Gemini AI vision analysis on top ads (extracts hooks, pain points, emotional triggers). Adds latency and cost. Used by: analyze_domain_winners.

maxResults.title: Max Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to return (per platform for analyze_domain_winners). Used by: all actions.

country.title: Country
country.description: ISO country code for ad targeting (e.g., "US", "GB", "BR"). Used by: analyze_domain_winners, get_raw_fb_ads.

creativeUrl.title: Creative URL
creativeUrl.description: Direct URL to a video or image ad creative to analyze. Used by: extract_marketing_hooks.

advertiserName.title: Advertiser Name
advertiserName.description: Advertiser name for context (optional). Used by: extract_marketing_hooks.

industry.title: Industry
industry.description: Industry for context (optional). Used by: extract_marketing_hooks.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Industry or product keyword (e.g., "skincare", "fitness app"). Used by: get_trend_report, get_raw_tiktok_ads.

region.title: TikTok Region
region.description: TikTok region for trend/content search. Used by: get_trend_report, get_raw_tiktok_ads.

timeRange.title: Time Range
timeRange.description: Time range for trend data. Used by: get_trend_report.

startDate.title: Ad Start Date
startDate.description: When the ad started running (ISO date, e.g., "2025-06-01"). Used by: ad_profitability_score.

impressionsLower.title: Impressions Lower Bound
impressionsLower.description: Lower bound of impression range. Used by: ad_profitability_score.

impressionsUpper.title: Impressions Upper Bound
impressionsUpper.description: Upper bound of impression range. Used by: ad_profitability_score.

platforms.title: Platforms (for scoring)
platforms.description: Platforms where the ad is running (for cross-platform scoring). Used by: ad_profitability_score.
